purpose: Say casually that a condition still would not change the result.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Verb た-form + って; い-adjective stem + くたって / かったって; noun / な-adjective + だって
Even if we run now, we will not make it.
Even if it is cheap, I will not buy it unless I need it.
Even a child can understand that difference.
formation: Verb た-form + って; い-adjective stem + くたって / かったって; noun / な-adjective + だって
restrictions: A contracted concessive form related to ても; not the hearsay だって.
mistake: 行ったって here means even if you go, not someone said they went.
